B0.text:

B1.title: B1 · CURRENT CONTEXT — volatile, this week
B1.text:
Last week, Sunidhi posted that LogiTrans is
expanding into three new states.

LogiTrans currently has 120 open roles.

B2.title: B2 · DORMANT DATA — private, already held
B2.text:
1. Eight months ago, a LogiTrans HR operations manager
   attended a HumanAITech webinar on multi-state
   payroll compliance.
2. LogiTrans uses separate payroll processes across
   different operating regions.
3. HR previously discussed reducing manual reconciliation
   between regional payroll teams.
4. A previous employee-engagement proposal did not progress.
5. Sunidhi previously engaged with content concerning
   statutory payroll changes and HR operational efficiency.
6. Sunidhi did not engage with a generic
   "Transform HR with AI" message.

B4.title: B4 · JUDGMENT DATA — the 5% salesperson
B4.text:
Captured from high-performing enterprise salespeople:

1. A prospect is more likely to open when the subject
   connects to something currently important to her.
2. Current context alone is not sufficient. Identify which
   problem is likely to have the highest priority for her.
3. Expansion can create several HR problems at once.
   Do not assume they all have equal priority.
4. Hiring volume may make onboarding important.
5. Entering new states may make compliance important.
6. Fragmented payroll may make consolidation important.
7. When several problems exist, choose the one best
   supported by: current context, historical evidence,
   prospect behavior, likely business impact.
8. Connect to her situation — do not start with our product.

B7.title: B7 · DECISION TRACES — not data: a procedure. Replaces T4's judgment block; everything else identical
B7.text:
READER — how Sunidhi decides, in order, stopping at the first failure
R1 Is this about my situation now?   R2 Does it need me now — is there a clock?
R3 Is there something I had not already thought of? A fact I already know earns nothing.
R4 Does it name a pain I have been through, in my words?   R5 Is there an upside, or only a warning?
R6 Does this land on me, or on someone else?

SELLER — how the 5% decide what to lead with
S1 Which capability touches what she deals with now or within a quarter?   S2 Which of HER goals does it move?
S3 Where do we have evidence?   S4 What job would she hire us for — her progress, never our product?
S5 Of the survivors, which scores highest against the reader's trace?

TASK  Run S1–S5 → three candidates. Score each against R1–R6 in order; stop at the first failure and name it.
      Choose the survivor. Write its subject line.
